name: H1 hinglish, messy, ranges
text: yaar mujhe pichle 8-9 mahine se period ke pehle aur uske dauran bahut dard rehta hai, pet ke neeche wala hissa. kabhi kabhi 7 ya 8 out of 10. office se chhutti leni padti hai almost har mahine. ibuprofen leti hu par kuch khaas fayda nahi hota. mummy ko bhi aisa hi tha.

name: H2 hindi (Devanagari)
text: मुझे पिछले तीन सालों से माहवारी के दौरान बहुत तेज़ पेट दर्द होता है। दर्द की दवा से भी आराम नहीं मिलता। कभी-कभी थकान और कमज़ोरी भी रहती है। सेक्स के समय भी दर्द होता है।

name: H3 english, spelled-out number
text: For about eighteen months I have had pelvic cramps that start two days before my period and last through it. It is around a 6 out of 10. Naproxen takes the edge off. I also get bad bloating.

name: H4 mixed English + Hinglish
text: Doctor ne bola ultrasound normal hai but I still have severe cramps every cycle. It has been 2 years. Weight badhne ke baad se hi irregular periods bhi hain, around 45 din ka gap. Pimples bahut hain face par.

name: H5 fragmented, messy
text: periods mein dard... bahut. like really bad. cant go to class some days. sleep also gets ruined. took crocin, helped a bit. not sure how long exactly, maybe since school?
